newsitem.title: USA: Aames Financial files $300 mln shelf offer.
newsitem.headline: Aames Financial files $300 mln shelf offer.

text.p: Aames Financial Corp on Monday filed a shelf registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to $300 million in debt securities and common stock.

Net proceeds will be used to provide the company with additional capital to fund its growth, including increasing the amount of loans it can fund and hold for pooling and sale in the secondary market, it said.
Proceeds will also be used for general corporate purposes and possible acquisitions of other related businesses as opportunities arise, it added.
The company did not list any underwriters.
